label: W31 SyncEnvPool step throughput baseline (FakeEnv CPU; not a real-env hardware baseline)
notes: FakeEnv is a trivial counter — these are pool-overhead + Python loop cost, NOT real FrankaKitchen step latency.
Expected real FrankaKitchen (MuJoCo+dm_control) per-env step latency: 10-50ms (per W30 ADR W30.4 acceptance gate).
Pool overhead as num_envs grows: 64-env pool runs at ~1.6 us/env-step = ~3x slower per-env than single-env pool, dominated by Python loop dispatch in sync implementation.
Real-env baseline pending mujoco+dm_control install (deferred-import contract on FrankaKitchenEnv surfaces a clean ImportError when missing).
W34 PPO rollout collection (sync path) expected to scale near-linearly up to ~16 envs before Python GIL contention matters.
